text:
Maria L: Quick heads-up — opened a docs PR that merges kv-prefetch guidance into the Optimize toolkit page. It also adds a short example of using batching + 4-bit quant profiles for short sequences. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/314

Devin P: Thanks — dropping a link. I noticed the SDK snippet uses the old factory signature, will need a small update for the new RequestOptions param.

Maria L: Yep, saw that. I left a TODO in the PR comment. The snippet is in js/examples/kv-prefetch.md — I can push a follow-up but wanted to see if someone from eng-runtime can validate the perf claims first (@Sasha M?).

Sasha M: I'll run a quick microbenchmark later today. Two questions: 1) For short seqs (<32) we should recommend reducing continuous batching (lower max_batch and shorter agg window)? 2) The quant profile table lists q4_0 and q4_K; we need to clarify guidance for stable vs. throughput workloads.

Maria L: Good call. I propose adding a one-line rule: "For short-latency-sensitive requests (<=32 tokens) prefer low-batch and q4_0 for best latency; q4_K gives better density for throughput workloads." Can we validate numbers before we ship?

Kyle R: I can validate on a T4 and an A10 tonight. I'll post the microbench logs (will include cmd and flamegraphs). Also found two broken links in the migration guide -> I'll open a quick PR to fix anchors.

Devin P: FYI the JS snippet change is trivial — swapping factory(...) to newClient({ requestOptions: ... }). I can send a tiny patch once Kyle confirms the benches so numbers in the callout are accurate.

Maria L: Also thinking about UX: add a small "when to use" bullet under the quant profile table, and a short note near the batching section about prefetched KV caching interplay (cache hit vs batch size tradeoff).

docs-bot: Reminder — docs PRs require at least one engineering + one docs reviewer before merge. Labelled: needs-eng-review.

Maria L: Action items: (1) Kyle to add bench logs and link-fix PR, (2) Sasha to confirm latency/throughput numbers and advise batch/window defaults, (3) Devin to patch the SDK snippet signature. I'll squash and rebase after those land and then request a final pass. Thanks everyone :rocket:
